map.实心圆截面（直径 d）：截面二次矩 I = π·d⁴ ÷ 64（m⁴，输出另×1: Solid circular section (diameter d): second moment of area I = π·d⁴ ÷ 64 (m⁴, also ×10¹² for mm⁴) and elastic section modulus W = π·d³ ÷ 32 (m³, also ×10⁹ for mm³); linked value: radius r = d ÷ 2 (m). Validation: d is required; an empty value returns "Please enter the necessary parameters before calculating." and stops (no 0 fallback). Criterion: no fixed grading; I scales with d⁴ and W with d³, so doubling the diameter raises I by 16 times.
